patch.value: GH-1631: expose bounded extension-owned diagnostics on expected SDK errors

GitHub report https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1631 requests a namespaced JSON-compatible extension diagnostics slot on PmCliErrorContext and createPmCliExpectedError. Its concrete producer is pm-changelog issue 302: selection_report loses structure through host-owned prose fields. Design typed SDK and CLI/TOON/JSON contracts with size bounds and explicit exclusion from telemetry/Sentry; avoid widening arbitrary error payload capture.

Cover public SDK typing and separately bundled expected errors; preserve nested safe JSON diagnostics in JSON and TOON; enforce bounded output and prove telemetry/Sentry exclusion with real local collectors; coordinate pm-changelog producer adoption in its own repository.
Extensions return actionable structured refusal facts through a documented namespaced SDK field, with deterministic budgets and no diagnostic payload entering telemetry or Sentry.
